title: Redesign the Ride tab
question: Three ways to lay out Home, all in Pasyar's own colours and type, all map-first, all keeping Multi-day as a card. Pick the one to build.

options.label: Say it in one line
options.thesis: The sheet reads as one sentence the rider finishes: I'VE GOT ABOUT 4 HRS. Four compact cards change the blank.
options.viewport: Map fills the top 60% with a reach ring around the rider; the sheet opens with a big condensed sentence that updates as you pick a card, a 2x2 card grid, Avoid highways, and GENERATE LOOP.
options.risk: The sentence repeats what the selected card says; it has to earn its size by being the clearest thing on screen.

options.label: Tap a length, go
options.thesis: Every duration card is the button: one tap makes that loop. No separate Generate step.
options.viewport: Map fills the top half; below it a short title and four full-width action cards (QUICK, HALF-DAY, FULL DAY, MULTI-DAY), each ending in a go arrow, with Avoid highways as a chip above them.
options.risk: One tap spends a generate from the hourly quota; a mis-tap with gloves starts building a loop you didn't want (Back undoes it).

options.label: Back by…
options.thesis: Choose by when you'll be home, not by length: each card leads with a real return time worked out from now.
options.viewport: Map on top; sheet headline BACK BY 1:40 PM in big condensed type; three across cards (QUICK / HALF-DAY / FULL DAY) with their return times, Multi-day as a wide card below, then GENERATE LOOP.
options.risk: Return times are estimates; a rider who stops long at the falls will be later than promised.
